Yes, use them, but not on every set. Grip is a separate thing to train from your back, and if it's ending your sets early, your back isn't getting the work you're programming it for.

A good rule is to do your warm-ups and lighter sets bare-handed, then strap up for the heavy top sets or high-rep work where grip is the limiter. A mixed or hook grip is worth trying too, since an overhand-overhand grip is the weakest option. Add some direct grip work like heavy holds or farmer carries on the side so it catches up over time.

If you'd like, I can add farmer carries to your program.
